name: – § 4 – Am 46/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: ‘Believes that Russia, supported by its allies including Belarus, China, North Korea and Iran, is the most significant direct and indirect threat to the EU and its security, as well as that of EU candidate countries and partners; reiterates its condemnation, in the strongest possible terms, of Russia’s unprovoked, illegal and unjustified war of aggression against Ukraine;’
